body:
This is not filled in properly, you have just copied the same into multiple sections

Please also try 4.6.2 or [4.7.dev5](https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-7-dev-5/) to make sure this still happens

Reproducible in:
- v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]
- v4.7.beta3.official [860821708]
- v4.7.beta2.official [777579205]
- v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e]
- v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]
- v4.6.3.rc1.official [6357d9e4c]
- v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

The open button is disabled when one of these dialogs open:
- Scene > New Inherited Scene...
- Scene > Open Scene...
- the Pick a Main Scene dialog, that opens when:
  - a main scene hasn't been defined
  - the run button is pressed
  - and the Select button is pressed, in the Please Confirm... dialog

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/27cba6ed-1d7b-43da-8801-09c0c4bcf002

The open button is disabled the first time a dialog opens, but then the buttons state depends on if the dialog's selected scene is focused on the scenes tab bar.
- the open button always opens in a disabled state, if the dialog's selected scene is focused on the scenes tab bar
- the open button remembers the state it was in the last time one of the dialogs above was closed, if the dialog's selected scene isn't focused on the scenes tab bar


Workaround:
The open button becomes enabled when the selected scene is deselected and selected, but the selected scene can also be opened, when the open button is disabled, by:
- double-clicking on the scene
- pressing: enter

Steps:
- create a new project
- in the scene panel, click on the button: 2D Scene
- save the scene with the default name: node_2d.tscn
With the scene open and focused on the scenes tab bar: node_2d
- open the dialog: Scene > New Inherited Scene...
- the scene is selected: node_2d.tscn 
- Issue: the open button is disabled
- Expected: the open button should be enabled since a scene is selected
- enable the open button by deselecting (click on an empty spot in the dialog) and select the scene: node_2d.tscn
- close the dialog (cancel button, top right x button, or press: esc)
- open the dialog: Scene > New Inherited Scene...
- the scene is selected: node_2d.tscn 
- Issue: the open button is disabled
- Expected: the open button should be enabled since a scene is selected

As long as the node_2d scene's tab is focused on the scenes tab bar, then the open button is disabled every time one of the dialogs above is opened.

But if the scene isn't focused on the tab bar, then the open button remembers the state it was in the last time one of the dialogs above was closed.
- open the dialog: Open Scene...
- enable the open button by deselecting and selecting the scene: node_2d.tscn
- close the dialog (cancel button, top right x button, or press: esc)
- open the dialog: Open Scene...
- the open button is enabled
- disable the open button by clicking on an empty spot in the dialog to deselect the scene
- close the dialog, and open any of the dialogs above
- now the open button is disabled

Expected:
Maybe the open button only should be disabled when nothing is selected, which happens when:
- there are no saved scenes
- an empty spot is clicked in the dialog
